column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline scan rule overrides for the pizza-store DAST gate.
# Format (per zaproxy zap_common.py load_config): each non-comment line MUST be
# at least 3 TAB-separated columns — <pluginId>\t<IGNORE|WARN|FAIL>\t<message>.
# Column 3 is a free-text reason (shown by ZAP); it is REQUIRED (a 2-column line
# fails with "Unexpected number of tokens on line - there should be at least 3").
# Consumed by the `ZAP baseline scan` step in .github/workflows/ci.yml via the
# `rules_file_name` input. Every IGNORE is a deliberate, documented acceptance —
# the fixable findings (CSP, anti-clickjacking, nosniff, Permissions-Policy,
# COOP, CORP, SRI) are FIXED in code (SecurityHeadersFilter + Subresource-
# Integrity in index.html), not ignored. Re-evaluate on each ZAP stable-image
# bump; remove an entry if the underlying finding no longer fires.
# 10017 Cross-Domain JavaScript Source File Inclusion: jQuery/STOMP/Bootstrap are
#   loaded from pinned CDN URLs, each guarded by a Subresource-Integrity sha384
#   hash + crossorigin=anonymous, so a tampered payload is rejected. Pinned+SRI'd
#   CDN inclusion is the project's established pattern; not a defect.
# 90004 Insufficient Site Isolation (COEP/COOP/CORP): COOP and CORP ARE set
#   (same-origin) by SecurityHeadersFilter; only COEP is omitted — require-corp
#   would force every cross-origin CDN subresource to opt in via CORP for no
#   benefit absent cross-origin-isolation needs (no SharedArrayBuffer here).
# 10049 Storable and Cacheable Content (Informational): demo app; not a finding.
# 10109 Modern Web Application (Informational): ZAP note, not a vulnerability.
# 10055 CSP analysis (style-src 'unsafe-inline'): kept for jQuery runtime styling
#   ONLY; script-src carries NO inline allowance (the high-value protection).

column3: Cross-domain JS — pinned + SRI'd CDN scripts (accepted pattern)
COEP intentionally omitted; COOP and CORP are set by SecurityHeadersFilter
Modern Web Application — informational ZAP note, not a vulnerability
style-src 'unsafe-inline' for jQuery; script-src has no inline allowance
